Consider the set of balanced presentations ⟨x , . . . , x | r , . . . , r ⟩ with fixed
                                                          1       n   1           n
n generators x1 , . . . , xn . By definition, the group AC n of Andrews–Curtis moves on
this set of balanced presentations is generated by the Nielsen transformations together
with conjugations of relators. Is AC n finitely presented?              J. Swan, A. Lisitsa
  ∗ The group AC
                    2 is not finitely presented (S. Krstić, J. McCool, J. London
Math. Soc. (2), 56, no. 2 (1997), 264–274; also V. A. Roman’kov, Preprint, 2023,
https://arxiv.org/pdf/2305.11838.pdf), while the groups AC n , n ⩾ 3, are
finitely presented, which follows from (G. Kiralis, S. Krstič, J. McCool, Proc. Lon-
don Math. Soc. (3), 73, no. 3 (1996), 481–720) (M. Ershov, Letter of 16 Octo-
ber 2025, https://kourovkanotebookorg.wordpress.com/wp-content/uploads/
2025/11/kourovka1889.pdf).
